title: Fix signup phone uniqueness, dual-role email rebind, and shared success payload

requirements.expectation: Duplicate phone on another account is rejected even when more than 500 profiles have phones; no .limit(500) scan of all non-null phones.
requirements.verification: Route test for phone_exists; code read of rejectTakenPhone using findPhoneOwners.
evidence: code: rejectTakenPhone keeps findPhoneOwners from security hardening on dev; no .limit(500).
test: rejects unsigned signup when phone belongs to another account; rejects duplicate stored as 080… via variant lookup.

requirements.expectation: Signed-in dual-role attach may still reuse the same user's own phone.
requirements.verification: Existing or new attach route test.
evidence: test: lets a signed-in motorist attach the Repair Pro role (same PHONE) and keeps the motorist side.

requirements.expectation: Attach with session/submitted email mismatch and keepOtherRole true rebinds to the session email for profile writes, confirmation email and success payload.
evidence: test: rebinds a mismatched submit email to the session email on dual-role attach (profile, sendMail, sign-in).

requirements.expectation: Attach with email mismatch and keepOtherRole false returns 403 identity_mismatch and writes nothing.
evidence: test: rejects dual-role attach when keepOtherRole is false and emails differ.

requirements.expectation: Session-ok and session-missing success responses share one builder; primaryService uses input.primaryService || input.services?.[0]; phoneVerified is included.
requirements.verification: Code read of session.ts; route coverage where practical.
evidence: code: buildSignupSuccessData used for both session outcomes; primaryService fallback aligned; phoneVerified preserved from phone-proof path.

requirements.expectation: nin_verified / bvn_verified remain Care-only; this change does not set them from lookup or digit length.
evidence: diff: changes limited to preflight, session payload builder, route email wiring and tests; no verified-flag writes.

requirements.expectation: npm test, npm run lint (0 errors), npm run typecheck, npm run check:server-boundaries, npm run check:openapi-drift pass.

code.detail: Checked after implementation: no further code work remains for these three findings.
